title: elaphoglossum gracilipes
intro: Elaphoglossum gracilipes, commonly known as the slender lipfern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is native to tropical regions and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Elaphoglossum gracilipes include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and possible antitumor effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Elaphoglossum gracilipes as a medicinal plant.
